result.title: Decoding Frozen Vision Representations for Training-Free Few-Shot Pineapple Detection
result.comment: Accepted in WACV HARVEST Vision Workshop 2027
result.summary: Few-shot object detection in agricultural imagery is hampered by dense vegetation, repeated patterns, and scarce annotations. We present a training-free detector that turns dense features from frozen visual foundation models directly into detections, without fine-tuning, a learned head, or external proposals: a whitened foreground-background direction estimated from annotated support images scores every query patch, and the score field is decoded with an adaptive threshold and support-derived geometry. We also test whether predicted relative depth can be fed directly to RGB-pretrained frozen encoders. On aerial pineapple imagery, the detector outperforms PET-DINO and GeCo2 at every evaluated support size; at K=40, predicted depth alone reaches 92% of the RGB performance with DINOv2, and RGB-depth fusion lowers counting error for both encoders. We release the Pineapple Plantation dataset (4,908 aerial frames, 1,995 annotated with 17,609 boxes, predicted depth, leakage-aware splits) and analyse transfer to two further agricultural datasets.

AI.brief_summary: 提出无需训练的小样本菠萝检测器：用支持图估计白化的前景-背景方向，对冻结视觉基础模型的稠密特征逐 patch 打分，再以自适应阈值与几何先验解码成框；另测试将预测相对深度直接送入 RGB 预训练冻结编码器，并发布航拍菠萝种植园数据集。
AI.relevance_reason: 对冻结特征做单一方向的线性打分，可视为「任务必要视觉信息能否从内部状态直接读出」的廉价诊断，其 patch 级证据打分与阈值化解码可供核查 LVR 的视觉证据筛选与停止判据；但论文不涉及多步推理或 latent 状态更新，迁移仅为方法线索。
